d: Post-gate colonies and interplanetary havens from Shinichirō Watanabe’s Cowboy Bebop.

mars.x: Thriving crater metropolis on Mars serving as humanity’s primary commercial and cultural capital after the devastation of Earth.

ganymede.x: Terraformed oceanic moon of Jupiter dominated by fishing docks and coastal ports; homeworld of former ISSP officer Jet Black.

callisto.x: Frigid, sparsely populated Jovian moon with snowy domed cities and desolate industrial compounds.

b.s: Classic space-western anime following bounty hunters across a colonised Solar System following the catastrophic 2022 Astral Gate explosion on the Moon.
b.r: Cowboy Bebop (1998) & Knockin’ on Heaven’s Door (2001)
